outcome: Cord blood concentrations of heat shock proteins (Hsp)
Cord blood concentrations of troponins cTnI and cTnT
Cord blood concentrations of glycogen phosphorylase BB (GP-BB)
cohort: Pregnant women admitted for delivery at >28 weeks gestation
finding: GP-BB and cTnI were significantly elevated in the umbilical cord blood of pregnancies complicated by preeclampsia, while Hsp70 was elevated in those with gestational diabetes, suggesting potential markers of fetal cardiac muscle insult.
mod_finding: cTNI concentrations were higher in the c-section group compared to the vaginal delivery group.
